why: Measured on a stick-figure pose library. Boogu Edit at guidance 9 kept the character's identity and lost its proportions, its scale and, in one of three poses, its legs. Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 kept all of them - and took 170 seconds a picture at 40 steps, which is not a production rate.
